'''Gorvan Shrulldike''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who pursued a career as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]].

==Biography==
Gorvan "Blackblood" Shrulldike was the former [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of [[Evram Darkmere]] and when Darkmere left the [[Daupherm Marine Corps]], they stole the [[Discril-class attack cruiser|''Discril''-class attack cruiser]] [[Retribution (Discril-class)|''Retribution'']] and set themselves up as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. However, Darkmere began to find slavery repugnant, so he defeated Shrulldike in single combat and took control of the ship.
